stage4_retro_gate.rule: every iso-rate kernel/codec idea is capped at B_achievable / L on its own platform
stage4_retro_gate.consequence: no iso-rate substitution (VQ4P, rANS, any gather kernel) can exceed 3.847 tok/s on M4; the only remaining levers are (a) reduce L, (b) buy bandwidth WITH capacity >= working set.
stage4_retro_gate.capacity_corollary: every platform in the table with >=315 GiB/s nameplate has DRAM capacity far below the 952 GiB VQ3R working set, so its DRAM roof is not reachable -- the binding resource reverts to SSD/PCIe. Bandwidth-per-dollar must be scored jointly with capacity-per-dollar.
